day_shape: 71 items: E3+US Quad statement at IAEA Board pressing Iran to readmit inspectors, US Senate rejects Iran war-powers resolution 48-51, Houthi missiles damage Riyadh's PIF Tower, IDF strikes Janta underground missile site in Beqaa, Khamenei amplifies Strait of Hormuz messaging.

threads.label: Quad pressure at IAEA Board
threads.summary: The UK, US, France and Germany issued a joint Quad statement to the IAEA Board of Governors pressing Iran to readmit inspectors to nuclear sites struck by US and Israeli forces. The FCDO published the text on gov.uk and the Jerusalem Post reported the Board-level push.

threads.label: US Senate rejects Iran war-powers resolution
threads.summary: The US Senate voted 51-48 against a resolution requiring Trump to end military action against Iran or seek congressional approval, with Democrat John Fetterman joining Republicans. IRIB framed the vote as preserving Trump's authority; the Jerusalem Post reported the rejection.

threads.label: Reported planning for renewed Iran offensive
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Trump is considering another major offensive against Iran, with Trump saying the US would see what happens after New Year's, while the Jerusalem Post reported Netanyahu tasked Mossad chief Roman Gofman with an Iran operation bypassing IDF Chief Zamir. A Jerusalem Post opinion piece cited US intelligence pointing to possible Iranian radiological-attack plans in Washington.

threads.label: Iran rejects US chemical/biological weapons claim
threads.summary: Foreign Ministry spokesperson Bagheri called US allegations that Iran is developing chemical or biological weapons a "repetition of old patterns" echoing the 2003 Iraq script, as reported via Defa Press and IRIB. The Jerusalem Post carried Iran's comparison to the Iraq invasion justification.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Riyadh financial district
threads.summary: Houthi spokesperson Yahya Saree announced four operations against Riyadh, Jubail and Khamis Mushait, with missiles damaging the PIF Tower housing Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund headquarters. Iran International and the Jerusalem Post reported window damage at Riyadh's tallest building; Defa Press and IRIB amplified Saree's claims.

threads.label: IDF strikes in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed airstrikes on an underground Hezbollah missile-production and weapons-storage site near Janta in Lebanon's Beqaa Valley, and separately said Harel Brigade reservists and the 607th Combat Engineering Battalion demolished a Hamas tunnel crossing the Yellow Line in central Gaza. The IDF also publicised a seized Hezbollah Imam al-Mahdi Scouts children's magazine from Bint Jbail.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and oil-trade disruption
threads.summary: Defa Press reported a second smuggling tanker in 24 hours caught fire after striking a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, while Iran International said a tanker was loading Iranian crude as Tehran weighs resuming exports in defiance of a US naval blockade. Khamenei's office framed the Strait as having exposed "the myth of American invincibility"; the IEA and Jerusalem Post reported the war caused the largest-ever disruption to global oil and gas trade.

events.title_en: Pentagon figures on cost of war against Iran jump by ten billion dollars
events.summary_en: Pentagon figures on cost of war against Iran jump by ten billion dollars. Pentagon official: War with Iran has cost the United States more than 48 billion dollars, though this figure does not include damage sustained at American bases in West Asia. According to Times of Israel reporting, this sum represents approximately 26 per cent more than previous figures announced by the congressional budget office, which had estimated the cost of war at 38 billion dollars as of early August.

events.title: 📖 NOT YOUR AVERAGE CHILDREN’S MAGAZINE “There is only one road to Palestine, and it leads through the barrel of a rifle.” This quote appears in a magazine published by Hezbollah’s Imam al-Mahdi Scouts Association, intended for children and seized by IDF troops in southern Lebanon. 🔎A closer look inside reveals: - A poem describing the desire to obtain a rifle and join the struggle against Israel. - A dialogue presenting Hassan Nasrallah, Ali Khamenei & Qassem Soleimani as role models. - An excerpt from a speech by Ali Khamenei calling for Israel’s defeat.
events.summary:
📖 NOT YOUR AVERAGE CHILDREN’S MAGAZINE
“There is only one road to Palestine, and it leads through the barrel of a rifle.”

This quote appears in a magazine published by Hezbollah’s Imam al-Mahdi Scouts Association, intended for children and seized by IDF troops in southern Lebanon.

🔎A closer look inside reveals:
- A poem describing the desire to obtain a rifle and join the struggle against Israel.
- A dialogue presenting Hassan Nasrallah, Ali Khamenei & Qassem Soleimani as role models.
- An excerpt from a speech by Ali Khamenei calling for Israel’s defeat.— Israel Defense Forces (@IDF) Nov 19
